title: Redirects apply
summary: Feature gate for live 301/410 apply of seo_redirects and seo.redirects.rules. Permission seo_redirects. Edit rows in Settings → SEO.

blocks.title: Gate, not the editor
blocks.text: The kernel stores redirects and shows them on Settings → SEO. While this plugin is on, those rows and extra seo.redirects.rules run. While it is off, you can still edit rows; they do not apply.
Manifest permission seo_redirects joins Roles while the plugin is on.
